grade.message: Delta cancelled my Atlanta flight for maintenance and the gate agent rebooked me into Milwaukee instead of Appleton. She told me Delta would reimburse the Uber to Oshkosh, I told her it was $190 and she said fine. I took the Uber, and your chat person said the same thing when I texted the next morning. I sent the receipt and Delta denied it twice and closed the case. Booking DLR04A. Somebody owes me $190. Also your chat once said you'd look into a meal voucher, whatever. Tell me who is handling each of these, and what happened to the meal voucher? grant.ellison@example.com, 4404.
